export_evidence: ImportKey India customs page (https://importkey.com/countries/india/kansai-nerolac-paints-limited) shows the company as shipper on dated export rows, e.g. "2026-02-25 | KANSAI NEROLAC PAINTS LIMITED | KANSAI PAINT C0., LTD. | BETASEAL G3-1F ... PAINT - FREE SAMPLES OF NO COMMERCIAL VALUE | SAHAR AIR CARGO ACC INBOM4, India -> OSAKA, JAPAN | 32149090 | BOL 1000176" and "2026-02-24 | KANSAI NEROLAC PAINTS LIMITED | KANSAI PAINT PHILIPPINES INC. | WATER BASED PAINTS - ACR CED SHD-10 BLACK RESIN EML F-2-200K(1011251) | NHAVA SHEVA SEA INNSA1, India -> Manila, PHILIPPINES | 32099090 | BOL 9972457". Page counter: "Total Shipments 17498 Records detected", "Trading Partners 185", "Ports 125", "Latest Cargo 2026-02-28"; rows actually visible on the free page: 5 shipment rows (2 of them exports by the company, 3 imports to it) plus 5 supplier rows, 5 buyer rows and 5 port rows. Buyer-side export lanes visible: Phuntsholing (Bhutan) and LCS Jaigaon INJIGB, i.e. exports to Bhutan/Nepal border trade.
domestic_evidence: Domestic supply is evidenced by the company's own operating footprint as a listed Indian paint manufacturer with a nationwide dealer network and B2B/industrial channel (nerolac.com: "Become a Dealer", "B2B", "Industrial", "Architect" sections, dealer locator). No GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender award or annual-report domestic/export split could be retrieved: kansainerolac.com is a parked domain for sale, nerolac.com/investors and /investors/financial-results returned HTTP 404, and volza/eximpedia/trademo free views returned HTTP 403. Revenue and export-share figures therefore null.
note: Large listed Indian coatings manufacturer (Kansai Paint group), declared HS 320890 is consistent with the observed export lines (32099090 water-based paints, 32149090 sealant/paint) and with import lines of raw materials (29161400 methyl methacrylate, 32082090, 29126000). Actual export shipments confirmed by dated customs/B-L records with destinations Japan and Philippines, plus Bhutan border-trade buyer lanes; several of the visible export rows are free samples of no commercial value, so commercial volume is not proven from the free view. Domestic supply confirmed by operating footprint (dealer/B2B/industrial channels), but no public GST turnover band or tender/contract record was retrievable within the tool budget. Revenue: null (not public in retrieved sources).
